bio.text: Jim McDermott is the Libertarian candidate for Alaska's U.S. House seat in the November 2026 general election, having advanced from the August primary.
It is his fourth appearance in the general election for the seat; he also ran unsuccessfully in 2012, 2014 and 2016.
A former noncommissioned officer in the U.S. Air Force, he has lived in Fairbanks since 2006 and has worked at the University of Alaska.

sources.title: Jim McDermott, a Libertarian from Fairbanks, makes top four for Alaska's U.S. House race
